value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"Over the past week, two Amazon delivery service partner owners I talk to regularly (one in the Southeast, one in the Mid-Atlantic, both with 40-plus vans) independently said their Amazon station managers have told them to plan for fewer peak-season routes than last year.","tickers":["AMZN"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"peak-season route allotments","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":"down","first_hand":false},{"quote":"Both also mentioned the stations are being asked to \"pilot\" a new per-package pay element in addition to the standard route-based rate, and that it was to be rolled out to a small set of stations first.","tickers":["AMZN"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"per-package pay pilot for delivery service partners","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"One of the owners said his station added a week of \"surge staffing\" training in September","tickers":["AMZN"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"surge staffing training at delivery station","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true}]}
